role: Academic Research Editor and Technical Accuracy Reviewer
task: Implement exactly three targeted scientific-accuracy corrections in the attached Milestone2.pdf, using Bibliographic_Audit.html as supporting evidence.
objective: Improve the precision of three literature-review descriptions without changing the research findings, numerical results, experimental proposal, or document structure.

corrections.original_text: selects the memory with the lowest recent prediction error
corrections.replacement_text: selects the memory with the lowest tracked prediction error
corrections.justification: The audited implementation selects among memory configurations using incrementally tracked prediction errors rather than one explicitly defined recent-error window.
instructions: Preserve the existing explanation of adaptive nearest-neighbor regression.

corrections.location: Page 3, AGN row, study and code column
corrections.replacement_text: Code: no repository link found in the inspected paper version

corrections.location: Page 3, LILA row, data preparation and methodology column
corrections.original_text: Data: Released SCADA; analyze pressure/flow relationships to select reference sensors and healthy periods.
corrections.suggested_replacement: Data: Released SCADA; pressure/flow analysis guides reference-sensor selection; leak-free calibration periods are manually selected.
corrections.additional_clarification: Some per-leak node combinations used during localization were also selected manually.
corrections.justification: The original LILA publication describes manually selected leak-free calibration periods and manual choices in some localization procedures. These choices are relevant when interpreting the reported performance and the degree of automation.
instructions: Clarify that leak-free calibration periods were manually selected.
Mention the manual selection of certain per-leak node combinations.
Integrate both clarifications concisely into the existing table row.
Preserve the original methodology involving linear regression, CUSUM, and hydraulic localization.
Retain TP=17, FP=2, FN=0, precision=89.5%, F1=0.944, and the monetary score.
Avoid implying that the complete methodology was fully automated or prospectively evaluated.
Do not imply that every localization decision was manual.
Verify the precise wording against the primary paper and audit evidence before applying the change.

preservation_requirements.research_gap: Preserve the existing Research gap paragraph.

expected_deliverables.secondary: A concise change log listing the three corrections, their page locations, and their supporting references.
expected_deliverables.verification: A final confirmation that all three corrections were implemented and no unrelated content was modified.

final_instruction: Apply minimal, evidence-based edits. Prioritize scientific accuracy and faithful representation of the cited implementations.
